description: This Dart source file defines the ReportsScreen widget for a Flutter app, which displays monthly summaries, weekly expense trends, and category breakdowns using charts and provider-based state management.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a detailed report with metrics, weekly trends, and category breakdowns.

classes.name: _ReportsScreenState
classes.description: State class for ReportsScreen, manages data loading and builds the UI.

classes.name: _SummaryMetrics
classes.description: A widget that shows summarized financial metrics like total income, expenses, net, and average daily spend.

classes.name: _MetricChip
classes.description: A small widget representing a metric with label, value, icon, and color.

classes.name: _WeeklyTrendSection
classes.description: Displays a title and an expense line chart for weekly expense trend data.

classes.name: _CategoryPieSection
classes.description: Displays a pie chart of expense categories.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides to load current month data on dependency change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main scaffold with a scroll view containing metrics and charts.

methods.name: _fmt
methods.description: Formats a double value as currency string.

methods.name: _daysInRange
methods.description: Calculates number of days between two epoch milliseconds.

methods.name: _toWeekly
methods.description: Converts a list of time series points into weekly aggregated data for charting.
